task: ADR-013 (Subsidiary Plan Approval Gates Before PMP Formalization): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Three-step route-aware sequence (Draft, Approve, Formalize); single full-authority TaskPolicy approve-subsidiary-plan; technical integrity hard constraints separated from governance flags per ADR-011 §3.2; staged section persistence in .staging/pmp-sections/; transitive STALE_DEPENDENCY status propagation bounded to DAG branches; remedial foundation breakout vs. graduation per ADR-011 §3.5; explicit plan governance state machine (§4.6, Invariant 9); IoC decoupled module purity (§4.10, Invariant 8); strict compliance with ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-005, ADR-008, ADR-011.

Five real alternatives named and rejected with explicit rationales: nine separate policies, monolithic 9-plan gate, status quo implicit PMP evaluation, autonomous LLM approval without human adjudication, and naive raw byte hashing.

Honest disclosure of consequences: positive attribution (plan-level vs. integration-level defects, §4.9) and baseline integrity against negative increase in procedural steps, orchestrator CLI adjustments (ADR-008 §4.2), and downstream functional requirement on unbuilt approve-pmp section/integration attribution.

Open implementation questions explicitly disclosed: CLI flag naming, LearningStore verification query signature, and deferral of word-count thresholds to ADR-012 Plan Standards. Bootstrap baseline accurately classified as legacy historical artifact without approved status.
